title: HOB: A Free, Open-Source Obsidian-Based Research Management System for Scientific Workflows
description: HOB is a free and open-source Obsidian vault template acting as a Research Management System for scientific workflows. It adds a stage-based folder taxonomy, structured templates, a dashboard, a macOS scheduler, a Zotero-to-Markdown literature pipeline, Bayesian project-duration forecasting, KPI collection, self-observability checks, and a vault-aware AI layer scoped to the knowledge folder. Research records remain plain Markdown files on the researcher's own machine.
